hints: Recall the definition of the mean $\bar{x} = \dfrac{\sum x}{n}$, where $n$ is the number of data values.
Rearrange the mean formula to make the total sum the subject: $\sum x = n \bar{x}$.
Substitute the given sample size $n = 10$ and mean $\bar{x} = 86.2$ to obtain $\sum x$.
walkthrough:
State the formula for the sample mean of $n$ observations in terms of their sum:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} \implies \sum x = n \bar{x}$$

Substitute the given sample size $n = 10$ and the mean $\bar{x} = 86.2$ into the rearranged formula:
$$\sum x = 10 \times 86.2 = 862$$

ai_rubric.Working with Coded Data: Relates the coded sum to the original total and mean correctly.

teacher_walkthrough:
Start with the fundamental formula for the arithmetic mean $\bar{x}$, which is the total sum divided by the sample size $n$:
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n}$$

We want to find the sum $\sum x$. Multiply both sides of the equation by $n$ to isolate the sum:
$$\sum x = n \times \bar{x}$$

Substitute the given numbers $n = 10$ and $\bar{x} = 86.2$:
$$\sum x = 10 \times 86.2 = 862$$

hints: Expand the coded sum $\sum(x - a)$ by distributing the summation across the individual terms.
Summing the constant $a$ over all $10$ values gives $10a$, so $\sum(x - a) = \sum x - 10a$.
Substitute $\sum(x - a) = 362$ and your total $\sum x = 862$ from part (i) to solve for $a$.
walkthrough:
Expand the summation for the linearly coded variable across the $n = 10$ values:
$$\sum (x - a) = \sum x - \sum_{i=1}^{10} a = \sum x - 10a$$

Substitute the given coded sum $\sum(x - a) = 362$ and the total $\sum x = 862$ found in part (i):
$$862 - 10a = 362$$

Rearrange the linear equation to solve for the constant $a$:
$$10a = 862 - 362 = 500 \implies a = \frac{500}{10} = 50$$

ai_rubric.Working with Coded Data: Relates the coded sum to the original total and mean correctly.

teacher_walkthrough:
Use the summation property on $\sum (x - 50)$. The summation can be split across terms:
$$\sum (x - 50) = \sum x - \sum 50$$

Adding 50 a total of 10 times equals $10 \times 50 = 500$, so the formula becomes:
$$\sum (x - 50) = \sum x - 10(50) = \sum x - 500$$

Substitute the sum $\sum x = 862$ that we found in part (i):
$$\sum (x - 50) = 862 - 500 = 362$$
